draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.28, the 52nd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 5th of 20 at S. He lasted until pick 96, well after his grade rank (52nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Kamren Curl. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (97th percentile), broad jump (84th percentile). College production: 66 tackles in 2021, 8th of 19 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Washington Commanders. 67 career games and 38 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 6 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: combined tackles 120 (96th percentile), season snap share 95.5% (88th percentile), approximate value 6 (80th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 safety who played: 95.5% season snap share against a median of 72.3%, above the norm.
